items.question: How long does a typical implementation take?
items.answer: Pilots are delivered in 14-30 days depending on scope. More complex projects may require 6-12 weeks. We define the exact timeline during the Blueprint.

items.question: How do you handle security and GDPR?
items.answer: All our systems comply with GDPR. We can work with EU-only hosting, encrypted data, and complete audit logs according to your requirements.

items.question: Do you need access to our data?
items.answer: We only access strictly necessary data, always with limited credentials. We sign NDAs and DPAs before starting.

items.question: What maintenance do the systems require?
items.answer: We offer maintenance plans from €500/month that include 24/7 monitoring, updates, and monthly optimizations.

items.question: What tools do you use?
items.answer: We primarily work with n8n, Make, Supabase, Claude, and other enterprise tools. We adapt to your existing stack.

items.question: What if we already have basic automations?
items.answer: Perfect. We audit what exists, identify improvements, and build on your foundation without starting from scratch.

items.question: Do you work with startups or only enterprise?
items.answer: We work with companies from 5 to 500+ employees. The key factor is the volume of repetitive tasks, not size.

items.question: What if the pilot doesn't work?
items.answer: We define clear success metrics in the Blueprint. If we don't deliver, we adjust at no extra cost until we achieve the result.
